name: Restream
summary: Multistreaming studio: broadcast one show to YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitch at once from the browser, with guests and local recordings.
best_for: creators, podcasters and marketing teams who broadcast one show to many platforms at once, without extra encoding hardware
skip_if: you stream to a single platform (its native studio is free) or you need broadcast-grade production control: an OBS-style tool fits better
honest_knock: The channel caps are the business model -- each tier buys a few more destinations. Seats are the second meter: Free and Standard include one and cannot buy another at all, while Professional and Business include two and sell extras at $25 a month. Price it at your real destination count and team size, not the sticker.

pricing.notes: Re-read on restream.io/pricing on 26 September 2026, with both the Creator/Business tabs and the Monthly/Annually toggle operated. Free: 2 channels with Restream branding, 1 seat. Standard $19 a month, billed as $190 a year (3 channels, 1 seat). Professional $49 a month, billed as $470 a year (5 channels, Full HD 1080p in Studio, 2 seats). Business $239 a month, billed as $2,390 a year (8 channels, website player to 1,000 viewers, 2 seats). Enterprise is quoted. Annual therefore saves 16.7% on Standard and Business and 20.1% on Professional, not the flat 'Save 20%' the toggle advertises. Add-ons are monthly on top: Clips +$19/+$29/+$59 and Webinars +$99/+$99/+$299 across the three tiers, extra team seats $25 a seat on Professional and Business only, and extra workspaces $49 (Professional) or $239 (Business).

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 6 November 2026 on the free plan: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We went through onboarding, read the plan screen, uploaded a 6-second test video and opened the schedule-stream form. We stopped before connecting any channel and before payment.
findings: Onboarding asks who will stream (an organization or just you). No card was requested. Two draft events, an RTMP stream and a Studio stream, already existed on the home page.
Straight after onboarding a plan screen appears. Free is $0 with 50 streaming hours, counted per destination, so one hour on 3 platforms uses 3 hours. Creator Plus is $19.99 a month.

On Creator Plus all three add-ons were ticked by default: Clips +$19, Advanced Cloud recording +$19 and Upload & Stream +$39. Checkout then showed 'Due today $96.98', nearly five times the $19.99 base price. A 7-day money-back guarantee is shown at checkout. No VAT line appeared.
Storage accepted our 6-second MP4 (32 KB). The counter went to 1 of 3 uploads and available storage to 66%, so the limit counts files and not bytes.

The file menu offers Schedule stream, Download, Trim video, Transcript (upgrade), Details, Rename and Delete. Create event offers a title, date with time zone, and a preticked option to create an event post in advance. Loop video needs an upgrade.
not_tested: Going live: no channel was connected and the event was not saved
Support, roles and invitations (free plan is individual use only), downgrade and cancellation
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
